notes.title: 2.1 QOL Update
notes.notes:
2.1 QOL Update:


 Added new puzzle piece feedback animations.
 Improved the cutscene animations
 Removed flicker effect on last stages. Puzzle pieces will remain flipped unless mouse hover.
 Removed extra pieces on last stages. This significantly made last stages more concise.
 Fixed scale of puzzle piece when being selected to match the board size.
 Better puzzle piece spawn on main story game.
 Resetting save data will not remove the ability to play "extra puzzles". (Tied to Steam Achievements).
 Also added 10 additional puzzles in "extra puzzles".

notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Hi, I'm excited to announce that I remade the game in new engine and completely reworked the core mechanics and the narrative of the game. Here's the short trailer: [previewyoutube=nl4O0j0PBAs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Main Changes:
	- Gameplay: Broken down into 10 minutes of simple puzzles.
	- Story: Removed the lengthy story content and focused on main intended themes instead. Same old MC delivering letter.
	- Sprites:  Reworked the sprites. I know it's not even average but I think it's much more simpler.
	- Music: Updated music and sound effects.

I hope you have fun with these changes. Thank you for supporting.
